Recorded responses for the Weather tests (no network in tests). Real answers from api.weather.gov and NASA GIBS,
fetched 2026-10-12 (UTC); NWS/NOAA and NASA data are public domain. Tests pass their own "now" so these never go stale.

  forecast_dallas.json      /gridpoints/FWD/89,104/forecast
  obs_kdfw.json             /stations/KDFW/observations/latest
  alerts_tx.json            /alerts/active?area=TX
